Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Hunchback]]: Marty Feldman as Igor in ''Young Frankenstein'' (1974), seen from behind as he looks back over his shoulder, with the hump of his back under his cloak. Brightened and cropped to Igor.

Source: a frame at about 17:33 of the film ''Young Frankenstein'' (1974), directed by Mel Brooks, 20th Century Fox, in the night scene just after Frederick meets Igor at the station. The frame was taken from the copy at the Internet Archive. Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/young-frankenstein-1974_202609 Internet Archive] (item young-frankenstein-1974_202609, file "Young Frankenstein 1974.mp4", SHA-1 e65d340eca3c9377ba974e72a4d857f757c98f03).

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: one reduced frame (600 by 615 pixels) from the film, showing the character whose line the card's lore quotes, the work the card's text refers to. It is used only to identify that work beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of it exists.
